title: London Underground S8-4  Stock, Scenic Line
description: This pack adds a Scenic Line; it is based on the S-Stock, as the S8-4 stock is an older train.
body:
This is a Scenic Line pack—a train based on the London Underground S7 and S8 stock. Featuring low-mounted headlights, it is a vintage train dating back to 1997—quite an old model—which has since been retextured using Blockbench._
